invitation.title: Defence family support survey
paragraphs: Lutheran Care would like your help to plan its Defence family support program in the Northern Territory.
Tell us about the support you have needed, what you received and what would help now.
Family members can take part wherever they live. Please answer about your own experience.
invitation.funding: The program is funded by the Australian Government Department of Defence through its Family Support Funding Program.

notice: Taking part is voluntary. Most questions are optional. Some ask about wellbeing, disability or safety.
We do not ask for your name or contact details. Please leave out anything that could identify you or someone else, such as names, addresses or service numbers.

Lutheran Care will use your answers to plan its NT Defence family program. We will keep them in approved systems, limit access to authorised people working on the project, and retain and dispose of records under our records requirements.

We will share project information with Defence after removing details that could reasonably identify anyone. We may need to disclose information to meet legal duties or protect someone from serious harm.
You can stop before submitting. We do not keep a record linking answers to your name or contact details, so you cannot withdraw your response after submission.
Contact feedback@lutherancare.org.au. Our Privacy Policy explains your rights, including access, correction and complaints.
This survey does not arrange services or follow-up contact. In an emergency in Australia, call 000. For domestic, family or sexual violence support, contact 1800RESPECT on 1800 737 732.
